item.title: Alan M. Turing (1950) - Computing Machinery and Intelligence
item.description: Turing introduces the imitation game as a way of investigating machine intelligence through linguistic behavior. Reading question: Does this approach assume human linguistic performance as the benchmark? Full text: https://spinchange.com/computing-machinery-and-intelligence/ . PDF: https://www.cs.unibo.it/~nuzzoles/courses/intelligenza-artificiale/papers/Turing1950.pdf
